snippet.title: Marienbad (1962)
snippet.description:
Marienbad is a 1962 Polish puzzle mainframe game created by Witold Podgórski at an Elwro factory for the Oder 1003. The game is based on an ancient Chinese game called Nim, and was officially presented to European audiences after being in the 1961 French film "Last year in Marienbad"

You can watch the video from a part of the movie here:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=82l8FtL6Og4
